title: docs(scripts): correct the absence pin's prose to the measured radius — packages/ (ruling A, #15097)
body:
Fixes #15097

Ruling **A** on this card (comment 5540568758, maintainer 2026-09-04, decision batch #35) accepts `packages/` as the #14878 absence pin's radius and asks for the prose corrections only. This PR lands the ruling's item 2 and nothing else: **no code, no `SCANNED_ROOTS` / `SCANNED_EXTENSION` edit, no test change, and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` untouched.**

Every changed line is a comment line. Proof, on the committed diff:

```
$ git diff -U0 origin/main..HEAD | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' > /tmp/diff-lines.txt
$ wc -l < /tmp/diff-lines.txt
76
$ grep -vE '^[+-]\s*(//|\*|/\*\*|\*/)' /tmp/diff-lines.txt   # non-comment changed lines
(no output — the set is empty)
```

## The two false claims, and the measurement behind each correction

Both were produced by this card's own step-1 measurement (comment 5537719160) and both were **re-measured on this branch's base `c4d1354e3`** before the sentence was edited.

### 1. "it EMPTIES the residue class" — 4 sites

`scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (`@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/runtime` entries) and both pins' docblocks (`packages/objectql/src/action-owner-key-single-source.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/action-owner-key-single-source.test.ts`) said:

> …all 41 tracked test files outside `packages/` are under `examples/`, so that one glob does not shrink the residue class, it EMPTIES it, and the case cannot be re-pointed at another member because there is none.

Two conflated classes. The examples glob empties the **narrow** class the SPECIMEN case stands for — test files outside `packages/**`, 41 to 0. It does **not** empty the residue class the CLASS-LEVEL case guards, which counts every tracked test file no hint of the gate reaches.

**Measurement, clean tree** (`discoverFamilies().byCheck.get('check:cross-package-test-inputs')`, the gate's own exports, `trackedFiles()` + `isTestFilePath` + `hintCovers` exactly as the case computes it):

```
clean-tree xpkgResidue.length = 13
   examples/app-crm/test/action-predicate-sparse-face.test.ts
   … 9 more under examples/ …
   packages/client-react/src/hook-dependency-identity.test.tsx
   packages/client-react/src/metadata-hooks-envelope.test.tsx
   packages/client-react/src/realtime-hooks.test.tsx
```

**Measurement, glob planted** — `'examples/**/*.ts'` planted into the `@objectstack/objectql` entry, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` run under the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 1 · held the lock 378s`):

```
  ✗ but no hint of this gate reaches a test file outside packages/**
  ✓ nor a .tsx test file inside it
  ✓ nor one under apps/**, the class with no tracked member to lose
  ✓ the KIND names the gate for every one of them — delete the entry and this reddens
  ✓ and that covering hint is inherited from a module the gate imports, not a population the gate declares
  ✓ the tree still holds test files no hint of this gate reaches (3), so the entry is not redundant
…
✗ dispatch-gates self-test: 1 of 1382 case(s) failed.
```

So: residue **13 → 3**, the class-level case stays **GREEN**, and **exactly one** case reds — the specimen. The three survivors are the `.tsx` tests under `packages/client-react`, which is also why "cannot be re-pointed … because there is none" is false: re-pointing is possible in principle. The corrected prose says so **and** says it is option B, ruled OUT for now, so the correction cannot be read as a green light.

Mutation confirmed on disk, not by an editor exit code: HEAD blob `32daef3c5dfa1d2acb3fa95eaff1b17d95b0356a` recorded, the Python anchor asserted to hit exactly 2 sites, the planted text counted with `grep -cF` (= 1), the mutated blob hash compared against HEAD, and `git diff HEAD --name-only` non-empty. An unconditional `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` (never a bare `git checkout --`, which restores from the index) and printed `RESTORE OK: blob matches HEAD (32daef3c…)` with `git diff HEAD --name-only = []`. The plant ran **before** the corrections were written, on a clean tree.

### 2. The `ci.yml` `crosspkg:` claim — 2 sites

Both pins' docblocks said:

> …a NEW top-level root needs a matching ci.yml `crosspkg:` entry too, which `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` gates.

That does not bind for `examples/`. `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`'s `SCHEDULING_FILTERS` is `['core', 'crosspkg']` (line 185) judged as an OR, and `examples/**` is already in ci.yml's `core:` filter (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:91`). **Re-measured with the same planted glob:**

```
PARITY_EXIT_PLANTED=0
OK: all 144 declared cross-package glob(s) (100 unique) are covered by `core` or `crosspkg`, every `crosspkg` entry still covers one, and the `test` job's `if:` still names both filters.
```

(On the committed tree, without the plant, the same gate reads 143 globs / 99 unique — the one-glob difference is the plant, which is what makes the planted reading legible.)

The corrected prose keeps the third edit as a real obligation, scoped to the roots that actually owe it: a root that **neither** `core:` **nor** `crosspkg:` already covers. It does not delete the two-edit rule.

### What is deliberately NOT changed

- The paragraph pricing the **prospective** hole ("⇒ Widening this pin to `examples/` … of this symbol's five surviving references, four were `packages/**` and one was a test under the showcase example — which this pin would not have caught") stays, per the ruling.
- `SCANNED_ROOTS` stays `['packages']` and `SCANNED_EXTENSION` stays the single `.ts` (ruling item 5).
- The "41 tracked test files outside `packages/`" figure was **re-verified** on `c4d1354e3` and is still exact (all 41 under `examples/`, 0 elsewhere, using the gate's own `isTestFilePath` predicate: `.test|.spec` × `.ts|.tsx|.mts|.cts`), so it is left standing.

## Tripwire (copied from the ruling, verbatim)

> **Tripwire**: the first stale `actionObjectKey` mention found under `examples/` reopens this card and executes **B** (the one-line specimen re-point in `dispatch-gates.mjs`, dispatched with that file in the surface) plus the two-place widening. Recorded here so the reopen path is on the card, not in a chat.

## Verification

Derived family, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (exit 0) at commit `a6517bbd8` — **48 commands, every one run, exit code captured by redirect before any pipe**. 46 exit 0; 2 exit **3 = NOT MEASURED** (stated, not counted as green):

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/.` Its `--self-test` passed (93 cases). Nothing in this diff can move emitted bytes; CI builds first and runs it.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` — same shape: `⛔ This is NOT a pass and NOT a finding: nothing was measured`, needs the built closure.

Named verdict lines from the gates this card is about:

```
check:cross-package-test-inputs   All 117 self-test cases passed.
                                  OK: 26 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared, and turbo.json hashes every declared glob.
check-ci-filter-parity            OK: all 143 declared cross-package glob(s) (99 unique) are covered by `core` or `crosspkg`, …
check:watch-hint-literal          ✓ 49 declaration(s) across 4 rostered name(s) … no unrostered spelling of the idiom in the tree.
check:nul-bytes                   OK (scanned 7446 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes).
check:ratchet-remedy-authority    OK  202 scripts swept …
check:test-source-alias           OK — 72 packages with tests scanned …
```

Always-runs tail: `check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs` and `--self-test` exit 0; `check:declared-population-live` exit 0 (`201 of 252 famil(ies) … reaches this tree's 7453 tracked file(s)`); `check-self-test-wired.mjs` and `--self-test` exit 0 (both also in the derived family); `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:watch-hint-literal` exit 0. `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, run under the shared verify lock on this same commit: `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 368s` / `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1382 cases pass.` — the identical 1382-case battery in which the planted glob failed exactly one case, which is what isolates the widening's cost to the specimen. Whole-repo `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, no narrowing): `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 87s`, no findings.

`skip-changeset`: this PR publishes nothing from any package — the diff is comments in one `scripts/` module and two test files.
